_sources: Two complementary sources, neither scraped wholesale. (1) AGN 2026 Fixtures Version 1 (agn.co.za, created 2025-11-10) — exact distances, start times, and the club league races that never reach an entry platform; stamped 'Subject to change*'. (2) entryninja.com/events/road-running/gauteng — entry links, commercial events, and fees; gives distances only as a range.
_fees: Fees are recorded ONLY where read off an individual event page. The 'From R__' on Entry Ninja listing pages is NOT usable: 'From R0' means a free 70-and-over category exists, not that the race is free. Brooklyn's real fees are R66.90/R174.40/R250.70/R305.20 against a listed 'From R0'.
_qualifiers: Nothing is tagged as a Comrades or Two Oceans qualifier. Neither source states it, and a wrong qualifier badge misleads exactly the runner who most depends on it. Deferred until there is an authoritative list.
